title: Avalanche Foundation's Retro9000 runs monthly C-Chain rounds with a live deadline (Round 5 closes 2026-07-17)
summary: Retro9000 is Avalanche Foundation's retroactive-funding program, distinct from Team1 Builder Grants, research grants, and the Blizzard Fund, and has no program file in the registry. The build.avax.network/grants page shows an active C-Chain Round 5 (submission deadline 2026-07-17 18:00 UTC) plus an L1s & Infrastructure Tooling track with a snapshot on 2026-07-14. Community voting is advisory only; the Foundation makes final disbursement decisions.

title: CAIS runs a dedicated AI and Society Fellowship, currently unrepresented in the registry
summary: safe.ai describes a three-month AI and Society Fellowship on societal impacts of advanced AI, institutional responses, and policy development, with its own application page and a deadline of March 24 (annual cycle, next date unconfirmed). This is CAIS's clearest funded program distinct from its open compute-cluster access and philosophy course.

title: Cohere Labs' Catalyst Grants (free API access for academic/impact orgs) has no program file
summary: Cohere Labs' Catalyst Grants gives academic partners, civic institutions, and impact-focused organizations free access to the Cohere API for projects in education, healthcare, climate change, and sustainability, plus language-model-safety and values-alignment work per the program FAQ. Applications are rolling with no fixed deadline; the program is distinct from the Research Scholars Program and Open Science community.

title: NGI Zero Commons Fund's 13th and final call closed 2026-06-01 — no further applications
summary: nlnet.nl/commonsfund states plainly: "The thirteenth and final call of NGI Zero Commons Fund closed on June 1st 2026. No more new applications are sought for this fund." The registry currently lists this program as active with an open round through 2026-08-01, which is now stale — NLnet has moved new intake to NGI TALER and NGI Fediversity (see companion new_program proposals).

title: NLnet opens NGI TALER call (privacy-preserving payments), deadline 2026-08-01
summary: NLnet's nlnet.nl/taler/ page lists NGI TALER as a currently open call funding free/open-source work on GNU Taler and related privacy-preserving digital payment infrastructure. Grants run EUR 5,000–50,000 (at least EUR 676,000 total available for this call), deadline August 1, 2026, noon CEST. This appears to be one of the successor funds to the now-concluded NGI Zero Commons Fund.

title: Pharos Network is clearly active, not "unknown" — $44M Series A (Apr 2026), mainnet launch, new $20M grant program
summary: The registry currently carries pharos-network at status: unknown because buildonpharos.com stopped resolving. Web search shows the org moved to pharos.xyz, raised a $44M Series A in April 2026 (total $52M, investors including Sumitomo Corporation), launched its Pacific Ocean mainnet and $PROS token the same month with 50+ live dApps, and is running an active $10M RealFi/RWA builder incubator (Pharos Builder Base Camp, with HackQuest) plus a newly announced $20M Ecosystem Grant Program. This is a live, well-funded network, not dormant — recommend status: active.

title: Pharos Network launched a $20M Ecosystem Grant Program at its new pharos.xyz domain
summary: Search results (LinkedIn, pharos.xyz/blog) describe Pharos Network launching a $20M Ecosystem Grant Program, applied for via pharos.xyz/ecosystem, alongside a separate $10M RealFi/RWA builder incubator (Pharos Builder Base Camp, run with HackQuest). The specific blog post URL 404'd on direct fetch and pharos.xyz blocks automated fetches (403), so this is sourced from search-engine summaries of the org's own domain rather than a directly rendered page — verify before promoting. This supersedes the stale pharos-phase1-hackathon program on the dead buildonpharos.com/DoraHacks listing.
